title: rosa coriifolia var. bakeri
intro: Rosa coriifolia var. bakeri, commonly known as the Himalayan wild rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Rosa coriifolia var. bakeri are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
